message.content:
Sure thing! I can help you craft a quick, friendly note to Emile inviting her to hang out this Friday evening. Here’s a simple template you could use:

---

**Subject:** 🎉 Friday Night Plans?

Hi Emile,

Hope your week has been good so far!  
Would love to catch up over dinner/ drinks this Friday night—if you're free and feel up for it, let me know where you'd prefer to meet and what time works best for you.

No pressure at all; just thought it’d be fun to spend some time together outside work.  

Let me know what you think!

Cheers,
[Your Name]

--- 

Feel free to tweak the wording or add more personal touches. If you have a specific venue or activity in mind already, just drop those details into the body. Let me know if you’d like another version or something more formal/casual!
